title: The World Is Asking
in_plain_words: The singing is one busyness all through. The verse's lines run 8.1 syllables and the chorus's 6.6 (close to the same). Kept songs change: a wordy verse against a chorus of few, held words, or the reverse. Lines of clearly different length in verse and chorus would give the tune that change.
